results.name: Park Güell
results.principal_activities: Strolling mosaic-covered terraces, photography, panoramic city views
results.why_it_is_special: A UNESCO-listed Gaudí masterpiece set on a hillside with sweeping 360° views of Barcelona and the sea from Turó de les Tres Creus

results.name: Collserola Natural Park
results.principal_activities: Hiking, trail running, forest walks, birdwatching
results.why_it_is_special: Barcelona's green lung — miles of forested trails on the city's northern ridge, reaching 575 m at Tibidabo, with multiple free natural viewpoints

results.name: Montjuïc Hill & Gardens
results.principal_activities: Garden walks, cable-car rides, castle visit, cycling
results.why_it_is_special: A chain of themed gardens (Mossèn Costa i Llobera cactus garden, Mossèn Cinto Verdaguer water garden, Joan Brossa woodland walk) plus the Botanical Garden specialising in Mediterranean-climate plants, all linked by paths with harbour and city views

results.name: Barcelona Botanical Garden
results.principal_activities: Guided and self-guided botanical walks, photography
results.why_it_is_special: Opened in 1999 on Montjuïc between the Olympic Stadium and the castle; showcases flora from five Mediterranean-climate regions (Australia, Chile, California, South Africa, and the Mediterranean basin)

results.name: Barceloneta Beach & Passeig Marítim
results.principal_activities: Swimming, sunbathing, beach volleyball, seaside promenade walks
results.why_it_is_special: The city's most iconic beach, steps from the old town; the seafront promenade stretches north past Platja del Bogatell for a relaxed coastal walk

results.name: Montserrat Natural Park
results.principal_activities: Easy hiking, monastery visit, scenic cable-car or cog-wheel ride
results.why_it_is_special: Dramatic serrated rock formations crowned by a Benedictine monastery; gentle downhill trails through the natural park offer stunning views, and visitors can see the Black Madonna (La Moreneta), patron saint of Catalonia

results.name: Sitges
results.principal_activities: Beach swimming, 3 km seaside promenade walk, old-town exploring
results.why_it_is_special: A charming Mediterranean beach town reachable by a quick R2 Sud train; 17 beaches, a palm-lined Passeig Marítim with constant sea views, and a picturesque old quarter with the clifftop Church of Sant Bartomeu

results.name: Costa Brava (Tossa de Mar / Begur area)
results.locality: Costa Brava (≈ 1–1.5 h north of Barcelona)
results.principal_activities: Cliff-top trail walking (Camí de Ronda), snorkelling, kayaking, cove-hopping
results.why_it_is_special: A 200 km stretch of rugged coastline dotted with hidden coves, medieval villages, and crystal-clear waters — ideal for combining a coastal hike with a swim in a secluded bay

results.name: Parc del Garraf
results.why_it_is_special: A hilly natural park behind the coast with trails rising above the sea, offering wide Mediterranean panoramas; easily combined with a beach stop in Sitges on the same train line

results.name: Carretera de les Aigües
results.why_it_is_special: A virtually flat path carved into the Collserola hillside above the city, offering uninterrupted views over Barcelona and the sea — a favourite of local runners and a free, easily accessible nature escape
